login.title: User login
login.story: As a customer I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.
acceptance: The login page accepts valid credentials and rejects invalid ones.

Security regression: the suite verifies each known authentication-bypass vector of the application (SQL injection in the email field, known leaked or weak credentials) and asserts whether the bypass succeeds.
Accounts with two-factor authentication enabled require a valid TOTP code after the password step.

search.title: Product search
search.story: As a customer I want to search for products by name so that I can find what I want to buy.
acceptance: A search returns the matching products.
Non-functional (security): the search field must not execute injected script content, i.e. it must resist reflected cross-site scripting.
